T: We scare because we care. We cook because we're hungry.
D: Two monsters accidentally let a little girl into their world.
P: Serve the sushi when Mike takes Celia to the sushi place.
S: Mike and Celia's date at the sushi restaurant
Sushi rice seasoned with vinegar and sugar, rolled in nori with salmon and avocado, cucumber and crab stick, sliced with a wet knife. Soy and pickled ginger.
the abominable snowman offers them in the Himalayas
Shaved ice packed into cups and drenched in a lemon syrup of fresh lemon, sugar and water reduced together.
M: for the scarers after a shift
Chicken thighs marinated in soy, mirin, sake and sugar, grilled until charred, the marinade reduced to a glaze. Steamed rice and greens.
dinner after a shift on the scare floor

Ramen noodles in a rich miso and chicken broth with sticky soy pork belly, a jammy soy egg, corn, greens and chilli oil. Roast 600g pork belly at 160C for 2 hours, then slice and glaze with 2 tbsp soy and 1 tbsp honey in a hot pan. Boil 4 eggs 6.5 minutes, peel and soak in 60ml soy with 60ml water. Heat 1.5L chicken stock with 3 tbsp white miso and 1 tbsp soy. Cook 400g ramen noodles. Build bowls with noodles, broth, pork, halved eggs, 200g corn, blanched bok choy, spring onion and chilli oil.
W: all those doors on the scare floor

Buttery thumbprint biscuits each holding a glossy pool of raspberry jam, like a row of closet doors, dusted with icing sugar. Beat 125g soft butter with 80g caster sugar until pale, then add 1 egg yolk and half a tsp vanilla. Mix in 180g plain flour to a soft dough. Roll into 20 balls, place on a lined tray and press a deep hole in each with your thumb. Fill with half a teaspoon of raspberry jam. Bake at 180C for 14 minutes, cool on the tray and dust with icing sugar.
K: the yellow scream canisters on the scare floor

Bright yellow pineapple, mango and lemon slushie blended thick with ice, served in clear canisters with a scream of sherbet on top. Blend 600ml cold pineapple juice, 1 chopped mango, the juice of 2 lemons and 4 cups of ice until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 clear glasses or jars. Sprinkle 1 tsp lemon sherbet over each so it fizzes, and serve straight away with spoon straws.

s.note: Mike and Celia's date at the sushi restaurant
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, lay 200g sliced salmon, avocado and cucumber along each and roll tight. Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy and pickled ginger.

s.note: the abominable snowman offers them in the Himalayas
s.how: Simmer 150g caster sugar with 150ml water and the juice and zest of 3 lemons for 5 minutes, then chill. Crush or shave 1kg ice, pack it into 4 cups and pour the lemon syrup over the top. Eat fast before it melts.

m.note: for the scarers after a shift
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 60ml soy, 60ml mirin, 2 tbsp sake and 2 tbsp sugar for an hour. Grill until charred, then reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and steamed bok choy.
